ravi_marketing: Quick micro-thread 1: we need a boiled-down battlecard for SDRs focusing on procurement objections and a short benchmark blurb for the webinar intro. Keep it <1 pager. Deadline: EOD today.

ellie_research: Sharing sanitized bench highlights (internal):
```text
Workload: support chat, avg 280 tokens
Testbed: eu-central-1, A100-class nodes, 600 concurrent sessions simulated
Redwood (adaptive batching): p50 38ms, p95 110ms, cost-per-convo $0.017
CloudZ managed API: p50 85ms, p95 230ms, cost-per-convo $0.042
On-prem infra baseline: p50 32ms, p95 280ms (spiky), cost-per-convo $0.028
```

sam_sales: Procurement objections to prep: 1) "We already have infra" 2) "How do you handle sensitive data" 3) "What's the true TCO". Need crisp 1-line rebuttals and a short ROI calc.

beau_content: I'll draft the SDR one-pager bullets and a 1-line bench blurb: "In internal tests, Redwood showed ~2x lower p95 vs CloudZ and materially lower unit costs under the tested multi-turn chat workload."

ravi_marketing: Good. Ellie, include testbed one-liner and a short methodology note. Sam, pair with Ellie for ROI calc (1M conv/mo example).

ellie_research: Methodology line: "Synthetic traffic with varied seq-lengths; quantized model profile; steady-state GPU util 75%." I'll hand-off sanitized CSV.

sam_sales: I'll produce procurement scripts: 1) for "we have infra" -> "Our unified control plane and rollouts reduce ops burden and integrate with your infra; Dedicated & Private options available." 2) sensitive data -> "Private deployments, VPC option, KMS/HSM integrations + audit logs." 3) TCO -> I'll show per-convo math and reserved capacity uplift.

infra_bot: assets: bench-figures uploaded to internal storage (link removed for public)

ravi_marketing: OK assemble and push to one-pager. Keep phrasing conservative and mark bench as "internal" until legal okays. We'll iterate tomorrow if needed.

(END)
